# kuma

Usage of `prufyx check` and `prufyx prepare` for this project, as
`--project kuma --help` on each route prints it. Identity, stage and rule
coverage: `prufyx catalog cncf --project kuma`. Shared flags, exit status and
the reference text of each route: [routes.md](routes.md).

## check cncf

```text
prufyx check cncf --project kuma --kumactl-argv FILE --kuma-distribution official_upstream|custom_build --from 2.8.0 --to 2.9.0 (--now RFC3339 | --knowledge-db DIR) [--kumactl-argv-digest SHA256] [--replay-report FILE] [--format human|json]
```

## prepare cncf

```text
prufyx prepare cncf --project kuma --kumactl-argv FILE --from 2.8.0 --to 2.9.0 --kuma-distribution official_upstream|custom_build [--kumactl-argv-digest SHA256] [--format human|json|input]
```
